LUXE HAIR STUDIO — SITE IMAGES
==============================

Place your own images in this folder and reference them from the Atelier
Console → Images tab using a RELATIVE path, e.g. `/images/my-photo.jpg`.

Available image slots (override any of these in the console):
  heroBefore, heroAfter, salon, amara, sofia, elena, bride, color

You can also upload images directly in the console (stored as data-urls),
or paste any absolute URL. Relative paths in this folder are preferred for
a fully self-contained, portable site.
